baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence انشقت السماء ... واهية joins an opening rupture to an overhead cover that has become slack and structurally weak.
baseline_models.mechanism: A raised covering surface splits open; the breach loosens its binding and turns a formerly coherent overhead structure into one liable to sag or fall.

activation_trace.role: Physical splitting-open supplies the initiating breach in the overhead structure.
The overhead sky-as-cover image supplies the structure whose covering span fails.
Slackened binding and wall-like structural weakness make the post-split state a loss of integrity, not a vague diminution.

changed_reading.before: The sky cracks and is weak.
changed_reading.after: The overhead canopy suffers a breach, loses binding, and can no longer hold its former structural state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: انشقت and واهية share concrete cloth, hide, and waterskin rupture images around السماء.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky is read as a stretched membrane rather than an abstract region: splitting produces a material tear whose persistence constitutes its weakness.

activation_trace.role: The split-off piece and cloth image gives the rupture a textile-like material surface.
The sky as what rises overhead and covers supplies the membrane's spanning position.
A tear in hide, cloth, or waterskin supplies the persistent breach that defines the sky's weakness.

changed_reading.before: The sky becomes generally fragile after cracking.
changed_reading.after: The sky behaves like a torn stretched skin or cloth whose opened breach cannot sustain the old enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sole focus predicate واهية includes an image of sky or cloud spouts bursting with rain, while انشقت supplies an opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cracked overhead cover can be carried as a reservoir rupture: weakness is expressed by an opening through which held contents may discharge.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the outlet formed in the cover.
The overhead sky and cover image supplies the containing surface.
Bursting cloud spouts with heavy rain supply discharge as a concrete mode of the sky's failure.

changed_reading.before: The cracked sky is only a damaged surface.
changed_reading.after: The cracked sky is also an opened reservoir whose failure can release what it held.

context_deltas.mechanism: The striking calamity supplies an impact model, and the focus root's injury-by-blow branch turns واهية into damage induced by a blow rather than passive decay.

activation_trace.role: Striking one thing against another supplies the possible external impact.
The focus's physical split is the fracture produced in the impacted surface.
Weakening a hand by fracture or a blow supplies the packet's explicit impact-to-impairment relation.

structural_cues: The named striking calamity precedes the destruction sequence and the later focus rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies striking, fracture, and impairment; I apply the impact arrow to the sky. The live alternative is that القارعة names the event without describing a literal blow to the canopy.

changed_reading.before: The sky's split has no specified material cause.
changed_reading.after: The sky can be read as impact-fractured, with واهية naming impairment left by the strike.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bound-exceeding water and a wind-sending, inflating blast activate a fluid-pressure reading of the focus: a loaded overhead reservoir splits, slackens, and vents.

activation_trace.role: Water rising beyond its limit supplies fluid overload and boundary exceedance.
Abundant entering water supplies the mass capable of loading a containing boundary.
Sending wind into a thing supplies the pressure input immediately before the focus sequence.
Inflation by wind supplies expansion stress on the enclosing surface.
The focus split supplies the pressure-created breach.
Bursting sky or cloud spouts supply the discharge phase of the rupture.

structural_cues: Packet order moves from water exceeding its limit in 69:11 to a single blast in 69:13 and then to the focus rupture in 69:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, wind input, inflation, opening, and discharge; I connect them as pressure loading followed by rupture. The alternative is that the flood and trumpet are separate scenes and the blast signals rather than mechanically causes the split.

changed_reading.before: The reservoir-like baseline is possible but lacks an activating load.
changed_reading.after: The sky reads as a pressure-loaded enclosure that bursts and vents after water and wind exceed containment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lower solid frame is lifted and demolished to levelness, the event falls into actuality, and then the upper cover splits and slackens; the focus becomes one phase of coordinated vertical-world dismantling.

activation_trace.role: External lifting of a visible load initiates removal of the lower frame from its settled state.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary half of the vertical architecture.
Raised solidity supplies the rigid supports subjected to demolition.
Pounding and demolition to levelness supplies destruction of the lower load-bearing geometry.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the transition from process to an accomplished event.
The overhead cover supplies the upper counterpart dismantled after the lower frame.
Slackening and possible structural fall complete the upper frame's loss of integrity.

structural_cues: The consecutive 69:14-16 sequence moves from lower solids, through total leveling and event occurrence, to upper-cover rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired lower and upper structures and adjacent modes of demolition; I treat them as one architectural system. The alternative is a list of independent cosmic signs with no shared load path.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts an isolated failure in the sky.
changed_reading.after: The sky's weakness is the upper phase of a synchronized demolition of the world's lower supports and overhead span.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once the distributed overhead cover loses cohesion, the next ayah relocates strength to its edges and names explicit carriers supporting a raised canopy or order above them; the scene reads as a change in load path.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering span supplies the distributed structure whose support regime changes.
Loss of binding and structural strength supplies the failed distributed support state.
The mapped strength-and-cohesion image supplies concentrated stability at the post-failure perimeter.
The edge or side image locates the remaining support at the canopy's margins.
Visible load-bearing supplies the explicit replacement support action.
A raised roof or canopy supplies the object-form now borne by explicit carriers.
The standing or broken structure of an order supplies the systemic stakes of the support change.
Spatial above-ness fixes the carried structure over the carriers.

structural_cues: The immediate continuation places the malak on its edges and makes eight the carriers of the throne above them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed cohesion, edges, carriers, a raised canopy/order, and above-ness; I infer transfer from distributed support to perimeter carriers. The live alternative is that 69:17 opens a distinct heavenly tableau with no engineering continuity.

changed_reading.before: The weakened sky simply collapses or ceases to function.
changed_reading.after: Its distributed support fails, after which cohesion and bearing are represented at the edges by explicit carriers holding an elevated order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Breaking the overhead cover removes a screen: the next movement is display with nothing concealed, and the later uncovering root confirms removal of a covering. Structural failure thus also performs exposure.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open creates the breach through which concealment is lost.
The overhead cover supplies the screen whose rupture changes visibility.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies the display produced after the cover opens.
Removal of hiddenness supplies the explicit visibility consequence.
Uncovering and removing a screen confirm the cover-loss mechanism later in the packet.

structural_cues: After the focus and its edge scene, 69:18 shifts directly to public display and the negation of every hidden thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a broken cover followed by display and unhiddenness; I make the cover-to-exposure arrow. The alternative is that judicial exposure follows temporally but is not spatially caused by the sky's breach.

changed_reading.before: The sky's rupture is material damage only.
changed_reading.after: The rupture strips away an overhead screen and inaugurates a condition in which persons and hidden contents are exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The torn sky-cover ceases to separate or protect: later cues name an interposing barrier, damage-preventing protection, and being bare of protection, turning the breach into failed boundary function.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the spatial layer capable of separating and sheltering.
A tear in hide, cloth, or waterskin supplies an actual breach through the separating layer.
Interposition by a separator supplies the boundary function that is declared unavailable.
Repelling damage through protection supplies the sheltering function contrasted with the breached cover.
Being bare of protection supplies the human consequence of failed covering.

structural_cues: The closing sequence denies any interposer, identifies those who take protection, and then names a state whose inventory includes being uncovered and unprotected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, tear, separator, protection, and exposure; I assign the sky a boundary-protection function lost at rupture. The alternative is that these later roots concern moral agency and textual reception rather than cosmic enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a damaged overhead surface.
changed_reading.after: The sky is a breached separator whose former shelter and interposition no longer operate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping of السماء preserves a visible-mark branch; later seeing, a thing's own indication, a guiding mark, and manifestation of truth activate the crack as legible evidence of changed cosmic condition.

activation_trace.role: The opened crack supplies the visible form impressed on the sky.
A visible identifying mark supplies the crack's function as evidence rather than damage alone.
A sign from which an observer reads condition supplies the interpretive act elicited by the marked sky.
Direct sight supplies the observer-side capacity for reading the visible fracture.
A thing's own indication supplies the possibility that the changed sky itself testifies.
A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing supplies evidentiary direction.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies what the visible fracture comes to disclose.

structural_cues: The closing discourse moves through what is seen and unseen, true speech, knowledge of denial, and manifest certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible-condition mark, seeing, indication, guidance, and manifested truth; I infer that the sky's crack functions as a readable sign. The alternative is that all later evidentiary language applies only to the recited message.

changed_reading.before: The crack records only physical failure.
changed_reading.after: The crack is also a visible diagnostic mark by which the sky's transformed condition declares itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from physical canopy to epistemic covering. It remains anchored by the focus sky-as-cover and split-open branches and by later branches for covering truth and removing a cover; render it only as a materialized analogy, not as a claim that السماء lexically means denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky is the overhead cover in the focus, and انشقت visibly removes its continuity.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky-cover supplies the physical covering that can be stripped.
Splitting-open supplies the physical reversal of intact covering.
Removing a cover supplies explicit uncovering at the end of the packet.
Covering and concealing supply the human action materially reversed by the opened sky.
Veiling truth supplies the epistemic target of the physical uncovering analogy.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies what remains when covering is removed.

changed_reading.before: The sky-cover happens to break during judgment.
changed_reading.after: Its physical uncovering can enact the reversal of truth-covering: concealment loses its cosmic analogue as fixed reality appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a collapse image becomes a passage image and links a later textual descent to a physical opening. It remains anchored in the focus's splitting-open and narrow-entry branches plus the context's descent branch; render it as a possible spatial affordance of rupture, not a claim that revelation physically travels through this crack.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: انشقت makes an opening in the overhead السماء, whose split mapping also supplies a narrow point of entry.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the aperture rather than collapse alone.
The overhead sky-cover locates the aperture across an upper boundary.
A narrow opening through which something enters supplies the non-dominant aperture image.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies movement through the newly opened upper boundary.

changed_reading.before: The split sky is only a failing barrier.
changed_reading.after: The same breach can be carried as a threshold in the overhead boundary through which descent becomes spatially imaginable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it personifies cosmic architecture as a divided collective order. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit group-conflict branch and the next ayah's branch for an order that stands or is broken; render it as a social-political metaphor of rupture, never as the primary physical sense of انشقت.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb انشقت can activate the branch of a group splitting in conflict while its subject is the single overhead order.

activation_trace.role: A group splitting through conflict supplies schism as a secondary mode of the focus rupture.
The single overhead cover supplies the formerly unified cosmic frame.
An order whose supporting frame can stand or be broken supplies the systemic consequence of schism.

changed_reading.before: The sky undergoes an impersonal material crack.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its rupture also resembles a schism in the formerly unified cosmic order, followed by a reconstituted bearing structure.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes failure of an overhead load-bearing cover rather than generic cosmic weakness.
Overflow and blast cues strengthen a pressure-burst reading, while the striking calamity keeps impact fracture live as a competing cause.
The immediate edge, carrier, raised-canopy, and above cues activate a transfer of support after distributed sky cohesion fails.
Display, unhiddenness, barrier, protection, and uncovering cues turn the rupture into exposure and loss of interposition.
summary.what_was_special: The rare focus root و ه ي supplied unusually concrete wall, waterskin, rain-spout, and injury images. The next ayah's edge-and-carry cluster then produced a load-transfer model, while split mappings of س م و preserved readable-mark and aperture readings that a dominant-root synthesis would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Pressure, impact, and coordinated demolition remain competing causal models; packet order does not choose among them.
The transfer from sky support to edge carriers is a reader-supplied structural analogy rather than an explicit causal statement.
Readable-mark, covering-reversal, descent-aperture, and schism readings depend on non-dominant or cross-domain branches and should remain qualified.
